config.world: The D3 world with the observer family widened: tangent perturbations under the linearised flow of Lorenz-63 (sigma 10, rho 28, beta 8/3) and Lorenz-96 (N = 40, F = 8); observers as constant read operators including rank-one projections along declared unit vectors; random unit perturbations at starts on the attractor; one independent long trajectory per world for the leading exponent and the mean log read-fraction of the leading Lyapunov vector under every observer.
